name: cyclical-breeze-cannot-return-itself-while-resolving
notes: An Action card was put into the graveyard before its effect ran, so graveyard effects could pick or count the card that was resolving (Cyclical Breeze returning itself, Restorative Flame/Erupting Rhapsody/Lost in Thought banishing themselves, ...). The resolving Action's graveyard slot is now held back from ZoneSearch (DQ variable GAResolvingGY, kept current by GameOnZoneElementSpliced, cleared by PostResolutionCheck/ExpireEffects); its own 'banish CARDNAME' lookups opt in with includeResolving.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The resolving Action card sat in the graveyard while its effect ran, so graveyard effects could target or count it.
